summary: Ran `npx -y -p @angular/cli@14 ng update @angular/core@14 @angular/cli@14 --allow-dirty --force` from EFNgApp/EFNgApp/ClientApp on Node 16/npm 8 (after an initial `npm install` since node_modules wasn't present yet, which `ng update` needs to detect installed dependencies). This bumped the @angular/* packages to 14.3.0 and the CLI/build-angular toolchain to 14.2.13, and applied Angular's own migrations: dropped the obsolete `defaultProject` key from angular.json, bumped the TypeScript compilation target to ES2020, and converted the one untyped `FormBuilder`/`FormGroup` usage (in add-employee.component.ts) to `UntypedFormBuilder`/`UntypedFormGroup` to preserve pre-v14 (untyped) Reactive Forms behavior. The hop file listed no related packages needing a bump, and the pre-existing @ngrx/*@^8.5.2 / @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 peer-dependency mismatches (carried from earlier hops, mitigated by the project's existing legacy-peer-deps=true .npmrc) are unchanged. Install and build both pass; test fails the exact same pre-existing way as baseline and every prior hop (angular.json's test target points at a nonexistent root-level styles.css instead of src/styles.css), so no new regression was introduced.
changes: Upgraded @angular/cli / @angular-devkit/build-angular from 13.3.11 to 14.2.13, @angular/compiler-cli / @angular/language-service to 14.3.0 (version prefixes also switched from '~' to '^' by the CLI's own migration)
Angular CLI migration: removed the obsolete 'defaultProject' option from angular.json
Angular CLI migration: bumped TypeScript compilation 'target' in tsconfig.json from es2015 to es2020
Angular core migration: removed now-unnecessary 'entryComponents' usages (none found needing changes beyond the schematic run)

Angular core migration: typed src/app/add-employee/add-employee.component.ts's Reactive Forms usage to the new generic-less compatibility types (FormBuilder -> UntypedFormBuilder, FormGroup -> UntypedFormGroup) to keep its existing untyped-forms behavior under Angular 14's new typed forms
package-lock.json regenerated by npm as part of the update/install cycle
manual_followups: npm install still needs legacy-peer-deps (set project-wide via ClientApp/.npmrc in an earlier hop) because @ngrx/*@^8.5.2 and @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 declare peers on @angular/core ^8/^7; this hop again found no required bump for them. They should move to Angular-14-compatible majors in a later hop, at which point the .npmrc override can likely be removed.

`npm run test` fails before any spec executes because angular.json's test architect target still points at `styles.css` at the ClientApp root instead of `src/styles.css`; this predates this hop (present since baseline) and was left as-is per the rule that pre-existing failures don't need fixing.

@ngrx/store, @ngrx/effects, and @ngrx/store-devtools are still pre-Ivy ('View Engine') libraries per the build log; they continue to build under Angular 14's backwards-compatibility support but should be upgraded (alongside the peer-dependency fix above) before Ivy-only tooling drops this support.
